self_reference.rule: a match is an ANCHOR only if it is not the scanner's own record: the scan excludes its OWN output root, and classifies any hit inside an anchor-scan record (or a capture quoting the scan's command) as SELF-REFERENCE — named, never counted. Re-takeable 0: `--out` (and any stdout capture) belongs OUTSIDE the scanned scope, or the scanned scope must be sealed (t31/B2-F5).

policy.out_of_family: a POSITION citation (no literal string) and a BASENAME-ONLY citation (no `/`) are OUT OF FAMILY and pass silently, by design: this scanner judges a repo-relative literal only, so a green scan says nothing about those shapes (t31/B2-F3).
policy.scope_note: a plain-substring scan reports every file under the scope that contains the literal; it is a DISCOVERY heuristic, not a class rule (T-90's calibration bound).
